length_audit.scope: physical rows before edition filtering; proxy_tokens is suite metadata, not Clef encoded length

prompt_policy.formula: effective_max_tokens = min(Clef strategy MAX_LENGTH, served max_model_len)
prompt_policy.fixed_schema_overflow: Raises StructuredDecisionError before inference if prefix + schema + suffix > effective_max_tokens.
prompt_policy.state_overflow: Tokenizes rendered state then keeps the first effective_max_tokens - fixed_schema_tokens tokens.
prompt_policy.usage_input_tokens: Encoded prompt length after any state truncation; whole request counted once.
prompt_policy.input_tokens_equal_limit_interpretation: 4096-token requests indicate prompt-length saturation; this alone cannot distinguish exact fit from state truncation.
prompt_policy.exact_truncation_audit_requirement: Encode original requests offline using the same Clef tokenizer and prompt/schema algorithm, then compare full and served state tokens.

proxy_tokens.note: Proxy token counts from frozen suite metadata; not the service tokenizer or proof of truncation.

instructions_audit.policy: The native HTTP engine sends the original frozen state/questions without normalization. Current server instructions rendering is recorded separately.

choice_capacity_audit.interpretation: A CPU-side audit identified the current vLLM strategy choice limit. The native HTTP runner retains its own error/unsupported classification.
